items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked launch gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions/configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.
